content.value: A 3-phase full converter is connected to a 440 V, 50 Hz supply. The load current is continuous and its ripple current is negligible. The turns ratio of the transformer is unity. Find the rms and average voltages of this 3-phase converter for delay angle of 60°.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
